description: Fork of exp593 (1.4337 SoTA). SINGLE change: tied unembedder. Remove nn.Linear(D=384, V=32768) head (-12.58M params). Replace with: emb_norm = ln_emb(tok_emb_E.weight); logits = x_resid @ emb_norm.t(). Shapes match because D=E=384. New ln_emb = LayerNorm(E) with gamma_emb init=0.05 (~1/sqrt(D)) to keep init logit std ~1 (avoid the random-peak failure from yesterday's exp572-573). Same trick as exp574 (gamma_emb=0.1 at E=96) scaled for E=384. Net: -12.58M params, head bandwidth unchanged (same V*E matrix read for logits, just shared with embedding lookup). Predicted total ~248.5M params, trunk 155 Mbits, total 558 Mbits.
